MIGUEL PADILLA PADERANGA 24 JAN Sangguniang Panlungsod (SP) Member Gingoog City Province of Misamis Oriental Dear SP Member Paderanga: This has reference to your letter dated 23 November 17 requesting from the Secretary of the Interior and Local Government (SILG) for an authority/permission to practice your profession. You have stated that you are a lawyer by profession and also an elected SP member of Gingoog City. To answer your query, may we invite your attention to DILG Legal Opinion No. 33, s. 2017, relative to the rule on practice of profession of a sanggunian member. Quoted herein are the relevant portion thereof: "The Code allows sanggunian members to practice their profession, engage in any occupation, or teach in schools outside of session hours. There is no need for permission from other person or office (The Local Government Code of 1991. "The Key to National Development", Pimentel, p. 204). " In relation thereto, the Supreme Court (SC) in Catu vs. Rellosal reiterated the rule that the members of the sanggunian does not need to secure prior permission or authorization from any other person or office for them to practice their profession. The relevant portion of the decision is also quoted hereunder: On the other hand, members of the sarwuniang panlalawigan, sangguniang panlungsod or sangguniang bayan may practice their professions, engage in any occupation, or teach in schools except during session hours. In other words, theymaypractice their professions, engage in any occupation, or teach in schools outside theirsession hours. Unlike governors, city mayors and municipal mayors, members of the sangguniang panlalawigan, sangguniang panlungsod or sangguniang bayan are required to hold regular sessions only at least once a week. A.C. No. 5738, 19 February 2008, 546 SCRA 209

Since the law itself grants them the authority to practice their professions, engage in any occupation or teach in schools outside session hours, there is no Ion eran need for them to secure Hor authorization from an ther n or ceforan of these Hence, members of the sanggunian does not need to secure prior permission or authorization from any other person or office for them to practice their profession. However, may we remind you that there are limitations concerning the practice of profession of a local elective official. Specifically, the rules found under Section 90 of the Republic Act (RA) No. 7160, otherwise known as the "Local Government Code of 1991 " (LGC), and Section 7 (b) (2) of RA 6713, otherwise known as the "Code of Conduct and Ethical Standards for Public Officials and Employees", which provides that the public officials and employees, such as members of the sangguniang panlungsod, may practice their profession provided that that such practice will not conflict or tend to conflict with their official functions. We hope we have addressed your concern accordingly. Legal/01 DIR. ARNEL M. AGABE, CESO IV Region X — Northern Mindanao Masterson Avenue, Cagayan De Oro City, Misamis Oriental Very truly yours: By Authority of the Secretary: AUSTERE A.
